hypothesis: Can Qwen claims with exact source quotes, deterministic substring checks and DeBERTa NLI remove the three known unsupported additions from Gate 16D.8 without losing grounded answer parts?
boundary: Development test on the eight Gate 16D.8 conditions whose source shelf is English. Russian-source Q09 is excluded because the locked DeBERTa model is English.

nli.decision: entailment must be the highest-probability class

pipeline: Qwen sees the original question, coverage checklist and full shelf.
Qwen returns English atomic claims, each with one message ID and one exact quote.
Ordinary code rejects an unknown message ID or a quote that is not an exact substring.
DeBERTa checks exact quote as premise and one claim as hypothesis.
Ordinary code keeps only entailment claims and renders them as a bullet list. No second generative rewrite.
